title: नेकपाको जागरण अभियानका लागि कार्य विभाजन- कुन तहका नेतालाई कहाँ खटायाे ?
content:
काठमाडौं । नेपाली कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (नेकपा)ले दुई महिने राष्ट्रिय जागरण अभियान चलाएको छ। शनिवार पार्टी केन्द्रीय कार्यालय पेरिसडाँडामा पार्टी संयोजक पुष्पकमल दाहाल प्रचण्ड र सहसंयोजक माधव नेपालले जागरण अभियानको सुरु गरेका हुन्। नेकपाले आगामी स्थानीय तहको निर्वाचनलाई लक्षित गरेर अभियान चलाएको छ। अभियानसँग महाधिवेशनको तयारी पनि गर्ने नेकपाको तयारी छ। यो अभियान मंसिर २५ गतेसम्म चल्नेछ। नेकपाले केन्द्रदेखि तल्लो तहसम्मका सबै नेता कार्यकर्तालाई अभियानमा केन्द्रित गराएको छ। संयोजक र सहसंयोजकले अभियानका लागि नेताहरूको कार्य विभाजनसहितको सर्कुलर पठाएका छन्। अभियानका क्रममा केन्द्रीय कार्य संयोजन समितिका सदस्यहरूलाई देशभरिका विभिन्न जिल्लाहरूको समन्वय गर्ने जिम्मेवारीसहित आफू मतदाता रहेका प्रदेशहरूमा खटाइएको छ। कार्यसंयोजन समितिका सदस्यहरूले प्रदेशसँगको समन्वयमा सम्बन्धित प्रदेशभित्रका जिल्लाका पार्टी समितिहरूसँग नियमित सम्पर्क, मार्गदर्शन, अनुगमन तथा समन्वय कायम गरी राष्ट्रिय जागरण अभियान, सङ्गठनात्मक सुदृढीकरण र पार्टीका अन्य कार्यक्रमहरूलाई प्रभावकारी रूपमा अघि बढाउनुपर्ने सर्कुलरमा उल्लेख छ। ‘अभियानका क्रममा पार्टीका सबै केन्द्रीय सदस्य, प्रदेश, जिल्ला र स्थानीय तहसम्मका नेता तथा कार्यकर्ताहरू आआफ्नो मतदाता नामावली रहेको क्षेत्रमा परिचालित हुनु पर्नेछ’ सर्कुलरमा भनिएको छ, ‘गत निर्वाचनमा उम्मेदवार रहेकाहरू आफू उम्मेदवार रहेको निर्वाचन क्षेत्रमा खटिनु पर्नेछ।’ प्रादेशिक जिम्मेवारीमा नरहेका केन्द्रीय सदस्य पनि आआफ्नो मतदाता नामावली रहेको प्रदेश अन्तर्गत खटिनुपर्ने उल्लेख छ। सर्कुलरमा भनिएको छ, ‘पार्टीका केन्द्रीय सदस्यहरूले पालिका र वडा तहमा सञ्चालित अभियान टोलीको नेतृत्व गर्नेछन्। प्रवास अन्तर्गतका प्रदेशका कमरेडहरू पनि सबैलाई कार्यरत रहेकै देशमा अभियानमा जोडिने गरी सम्बन्धित प्रदेशले कार्य विभाजन गर्नेछन्।’ अभियानमा प्रदेश समितिहरूले आफ्ना प्रदेशअन्तर्गतका केन्द्रीय समिति सदस्यहरूसँग समन्वय गरी सङ्गठनात्मक, वैचारिक र जनपरिचालनका काममा सक्रिय रूपमा अगुवाइ गर्ने गरी कार्य विभाजन गर्नुपर्नेछ । प्रदेशका जिम्मेवारी तोक्न बाँकी रहेका केन्द्रीय सदस्यहरूको प्रदेशगतरुपमा अभियानमा जिम्मेवारी तोकिने सर्कुलरमा उल्लेख छ। प्रादेशिक जिम्मेवारीमा नरहेका केन्द्रीय संयोजन समितिका सदस्यहरूलाई अभियान अवधिका लागि प्रदेशहरूमा कार्य विभाजन गरिने उल्लेख छ। विभाग, मोर्चा र जनवर्गीय सङ्गठनको जिम्मेवारीमा रहेकाहरू पनि आआफ्नो मतदाता नामावली रहेको श्रेत्रमा खटिनु पर्ने उल्लेख छ। Kathmandu. The Nepali Communist Party (NCP) has launched a two-month national awareness campaign. Party coordinator Pushpa Kamal Dahal Prachanda and co-coordinator Madhav Nepal launched the awareness campaign at the party's central office in Parisdanda on Saturday. The NCP has launched a campaign targeting the upcoming local level elections. The NCP is also preparing for the general convention along with the campaign. This campaign will run until Mangsir 25. The NCP has focused all leaders and workers from the center to the grassroots level on the campaign. The coordinator and co-coordinator have sent a circular with the division of work among the leaders for the campaign. During the campaign, members of the Central Coordination Committee have been assigned to the provinces where they are voters, with the responsibility of coordinating various districts across the country. The circular states that the members of the Coordination Committee should effectively carry forward the national awareness campaign, organizational strengthening and other party programs by maintaining regular contact, guidance, monitoring and coordination with the district party committees within the respective provinces in coordination with the provinces. "During the campaign, all central members of the party, leaders and cadres at the provincial, district and local levels will have to be mobilized in the areas where their respective voter lists are located," the circular states. "Those who were candidates in the last election will have to be mobilized in the constituency where they are candidates." It is mentioned that central members who are not in provincial responsibility should also work within the province where their respective voter lists are located. The circular states, "The party's central members will lead the campaign teams operating at the municipal and ward levels. The respective provinces will divide the work so that comrades from the provinces under exile will also join the campaign in the country where they are working." In the campaign, provincial committees will have to coordinate with central committee members under their provinces and divide the work so as to actively lead in organizational, ideological, and mass mobilization work. The circular states that the central members whose provincial responsibilities have yet to be assigned will be assigned responsibilities in the campaign on a provincial basis. It is stated that members of the Central Coordination Committee who are not in provincial responsibility will be divided into provinces for the campaign period. It is mentioned that those in charge of departments, fronts, and mass organizations must also work in the areas where their respective voter lists are located.

The circular states that the members of the Coordination Committee should effectively carry forward the national awareness campaign, organizational strengthening and other party programs by maintaining regular contact, guidance, monitoring and coordination with the district party committees within the respective provinces in coordination with the provinces.

"During the campaign, all central members of the party, leaders and cadres at the provincial, district and local levels will have to be mobilized in the areas where their respective voter lists are located," the circular states. "Those who were candidates in the last election will have to be mobilized in the constituency where they are candidates."

It is mentioned that central members who are not in provincial responsibility should also work within the province where their respective voter lists are located.

The circular states, "The party's central members will lead the campaign teams operating at the municipal and ward levels. The respective provinces will divide the work so that comrades from the provinces under exile will also join the campaign in the country where they are working."

In the campaign, provincial committees will have to coordinate with central committee members under their provinces and divide the work so as to actively lead in organizational, ideological, and mass mobilization work.

The circular states that the central members whose provincial responsibilities have yet to be assigned will be assigned responsibilities in the campaign on a provincial basis.

It is stated that members of the Central Coordination Committee who are not in provincial responsibility will be divided into provinces for the campaign period.

It is mentioned that those in charge of departments, fronts, and mass organizations must also work in the areas where their respective voter lists are located.
